KEANO Kids Bike for Boys & Girls - BMX Style with Training Wheels
Built to inspire wonder and confidence, the KEANO Kids Bike is the perfect first rider bicycle for your child. Boasting rugged BMX styling and robust safety engineering, this toddler bicycle is built to survive the bumps of learning while making every neighborhood ride an absolute joy.

Ride into FUN: The durable, high-traction KEANO Kids Bike with custom DIY styling.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Safety first, smiles always. Engineered with stable training wheels and a fully enclosed chain guard to keep your young rider safe."
Safer Riding Features
The KEANO toddler bicycle is built with a premium carbon steel frame designed to take a beating as your child gains confidence. A fully enclosed chain guard effectively prevents clothing snags and keeps fingers safe from moving components. For reliable stopping power, the dual-braking system pairs an intuitive foot coaster brake—perfect for young riders who lack maximum hand power—with a responsive front caliper hand brake.

Heavy-duty steel construction paired with an all-terrain, smooth-rolling tubular tire design.

Child-Friendly Ergonomics

Dual Brakes: Front caliper hand brake and rear foot brake provide a foolproof learning system for stopping.

Full Chain Shield: Keeps the drivetrain protected from elements while entirely shielding your child from pinches.

Grow-with-Me Adjustability: A quick-release seat post clamp simplifies rapid height and posture adjustments.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Skip the setup headaches. The KEANO children's bike arrives 85% pre-assembled straight to your door. The basic assembly tools are included in the box, and a novice builder can typically have the bicycle fully setup and ready to roll in just 20 minutes. Simply attach the handlebars, front wheel, pedals, and training wheels, pump up the tubular tires, and let the fun begin!

<>
Assembly Video: Step-by-step tutorial to get your child's bike built in 20 minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
Children grow fast, and matching frame size to your child's current height is critical for a healthy, upright riding posture. Use our official fit guide below to select the right match.

See It In Action
Watch young riders build absolute confidence and pure joy on two wheels. The sleek, rugged BMX geometry handles smoothly on city sidewalks and park pathways alike. Plus, with the built-in saddle holding-handle, parents can easily assist with balance training when the training wheels are ready to be removed!

Riding Video: Experience the smooth pedaling, steady handling, and sleek style of KEANO.

Creative Customization: Included DIY Decal pack for personalizing the chain guard or frame with their name

Our Guarantee
We build our bikes to last. Your investment is protected by a Limited Lifetime Warranty covering our durable carbon steel frame. We also offer a secure checkout experience alongside a FREE 30-day refund or replacement policy to ensure complete peace of mind for your family. For any product assistance, our expert solutions team is here to help.
